scope: Constituent area-mean thrust motion and exact quantized allocation; frozen synthetic 40/20/10 m comparison

tests.duration_definition: Sum of the two recorded test-run durations; not a single full-suite duration.

superseded_failure.test: closed packet crossing a bend conserves each parcel over many increments and follows analytical flow
superseded_failure.reason: The previous fixture compared a finite occupied rectangle with its storage-top point trajectory; it was replaced by an independently checked area-mean oracle without changing production code or physical error gates.

observational_data: No observational development arrays, holdout arrays, or split files read or modified. Only enumerated source/tests/docs/logs and synthetic numerical studies were opened.
limitations: Numerical refinement is not field accuracy; 10 m is not ground truth.
Coarse-grid and local regressions remain; all recorded-field increases and eligibility changes are retained.
Area first moments do not constitute a persistent deforming polygon mesh.
Discrete packet allocation and open-boundary continuation remain sensitive to representation.
